stem.text: A cable of length $L$ consisting of two wires is used to connect a $12.0\,\text{V}$ power supply of negligible internal resistance to a lamp, as shown.

stem.alt: Circuit with a 12.0 V supply on the left connected by two wires to a lamp on the right. A double-headed arrow labelled L spans the upper wire. The upper wire is labelled 2.50 A with an arrow along it, the lamp is labelled 10.5 V.

stem.text: The potential difference across the lamp is $10.5\,\text{V}$. The current in the wire is $2.50\,\text{A}$.
Each wire is made of metal of resistivity $1.70 \times 10^{-8}\,\Omega\text{m}$ and has a cross-sectional area of $6.00 \times 10^{-7}\,\text{m}^{2}$.
What is the length $L$ of the cable?
